interface.shortDescription: Lintel — pack-driven AI-CLI session harness with 9-step cycle + role-lifting
interface.longDescription: Lintel is a company-neutral, pack-driven session harness for agent-based development. 9-step cycle (8 core phases + SCOPE: SENSE→SCOPE→DEFINE→DISCOVER→PLAN→BUILD→REVIEW→SHIP→CAPTURE). Role-lifting for persona context. Explicit context loading within the active model budget. Pack-driven compliance gates, voice calibration, doc-gen for PPT/Word/Web, and repo scaffolding for new engagements. Company identity (voice, compliance, persona, brand) is resolved from the active pack, not hardcoded. Supported clients: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, plus an explicit manual route for other hosts.
